INSERT INTO biz_student_answer (student_id, lesson_id, question_id, student_answer, is_correct, score, answer_time, submit_time, typing_speed, accuracy_rate, completion_rate, preview_status, preview_path, preview_retry_count, preview_last_retry_time, preview_error_message, practical_artifact_id, practical_version_id) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{lessonId}, #{questionId}, #{studentAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, #{score}, #{answerTime}, #{submitTime}, #{typingSpeed}, #{accuracyRate}, #{completionRate}, #{previewStatus}, #{previewPath}, #{previewRetryCount}, #{previewLastRetryTime}, #{previewErrorMessage}, #{practicalArtifactId}, #{practicalVersionId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE answer_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(answer_id), -- 同一操作题文件的重试不得把已成功/失败的转换状态重新覆盖为 pending。 preview_status = IF(student_answer <=> VALUES(student_answer), preview_status, VALUES(preview_status)), preview_path = IF(student_answer <=> VALUES(student_answer), preview_path, VALUES(preview_path)), preview_retry_count = IF(student_answer <=> VALUES(student_answer), preview_retry_count, VALUES(preview_retry_count)), preview_last_retry_time = IF(student_answer <=> VALUES(student_answer), preview_last_retry_time, VALUES(preview_last_retry_time)), preview_error_message = IF(student_answer <=> VALUES(student_answer), preview_error_message, VALUES(preview_error_message)),
is_correct = IF(#{keepBestScore} = TRUE, IF(COALESCE(VALUES(score), -1) > COALESCE(score, -1), VALUES(is_correct), is_correct), VALUES(is_correct)), answer_time = IF(#{keepBestScore} = TRUE, IF(COALESCE(VALUES(score), -1) > COALESCE(score, -1), VALUES(answer_time), answer_time), VALUES(answer_time)), submit_time = IF(#{keepBestScore} = TRUE, IF(COALESCE(VALUES(score), -1) > COALESCE(score, -1), VALUES(submit_time), submit_time), VALUES(submit_time)), typing_speed = IF(#{keepBestScore} = TRUE, IF(COALESCE(VALUES(score), -1) > COALESCE(score, -1), VALUES(typing_speed), typing_speed), VALUES(typing_speed)), accuracy_rate = IF(#{keepBestScore} = TRUE, IF(COALESCE(VALUES(score), -1) > COALESCE(score, -1), VALUES(accuracy_rate), accuracy_rate), VALUES(accuracy_rate)), completion_rate = IF(#{keepBestScore} = TRUE, IF(COALESCE(VALUES(score), -1) > COALESCE(score, -1), VALUES(completion_rate), completion_rate), VALUES(completion_rate)), practical_artifact_id = COALESCE(VALUES(practical_artifact_id), practical_artifact_id), practical_version_id = COALESCE(VALUES(practical_version_id), practical_version_id), student_answer = IF(#{keepBestScore} = TRUE, IF(COALESCE(VALUES(score), -1) > COALESCE(score, -1), VALUES(student_answer), student_answer), VALUES(student_answer)), score = IF(#{keepBestScore} = TRUE, GREATEST(COALESCE(score, 0), COALESCE(VALUES(score), 0)), VALUES(score))

SELECT a.student_id, u.nick_name AS student_name, s.student_no, s.class_code, SUM(IFNULL(a.score, 0)) as total_score, SUM(IFNULL(a.answer_time, 0)) as total_time, SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as correct_count, COUNT(*) as total_count FROM biz_student_answer a INNER JOIN (
) latest ON latest.answer_id = a.answer_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question current_lq ON current_lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND current_lq.question_id = a.question_id LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON a.student_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id WHERE a.lesson_id = #{lessonId} GROUP BY a.student_id, u.nick_name, s.student_no, s.class_code ORDER BY total_score DESC, total_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_student_answer WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND lesson_id = #{lessonId}

WITH selected_lesson AS ( SELECT answer.lesson_id FROM biz_student_answer answer WHERE answer.student_id = #{studentId} AND answer.submit_time >= #{startTime} AND answer.submit_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY answer.lesson_id ), answer_metric AS ( SELECT answer.lesson_id, SUM(IFNULL(answer.score, 0)) AS my_score, MAX(answer.submit_time) AS submit_time, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'typing' THEN IFNULL(answer.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS typing_score, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type IN ('choice', 'judgment') THEN IFNULL(answer.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS theory_score, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'practical' THEN IFNULL(answer.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS practical_score, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'practical' AND IFNULL(question.practical_mode, 'FILE') = 'FILE' THEN IFNULL(answer.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS file_practical_score, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'practical' AND question.practical_mode = 'PYTHON' THEN IFNULL(answer.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS python_practical_score, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'practical' AND question.practical_mode = 'FLOWCHART' THEN IFNULL(answer.score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS flowchart_practical_score, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'typing' THEN IFNULL(lesson_question.question_score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS typing_total, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type IN ('choice', 'judgment') THEN IFNULL(lesson_question.question_score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS theory_total, SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'practical' THEN IFNULL(lesson_question.question_score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS practical_total ,SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'practical' AND IFNULL(question.practical_mode, 'FILE') = 'FILE' THEN IFNULL(lesson_question.question_score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS file_practical_total ,SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'practical' AND question.practical_mode = 'PYTHON' THEN IFNULL(lesson_question.question_score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS python_practical_total ,SUM(CASE WHEN question.question_type = 'practical' AND question.practical_mode = 'FLOWCHART' THEN IFNULL(lesson_question.question_score, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS flowchart_practical_total FROM biz_student_answer answer INNER JOIN selected_lesson selected ON selected.lesson_id = answer.lesson_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question lesson_question ON lesson_question.lesson_id = answer.lesson_id AND lesson_question.question_id = answer.question_id INNER JOIN biz_question question ON question.question_id = answer.question_id WHERE answer.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY answer.lesson_id ), lesson_total AS ( SELECT lesson_question.lesson_id, SUM(IFNULL(lesson_question.question_score, 0)) AS total_score FROM biz_lesson_question lesson_question INNER JOIN selected_lesson selected ON selected.lesson_id = lesson_question.lesson_id GROUP BY lesson_question.lesson_id ) SELECT lesson.lesson_id AS lessonId, lesson.lesson_title AS lessonTitle, IFNULL(lesson_total.total_score, 0) AS totalScore, IFNULL(answer_metric.my_score, 0) AS myScore, answer_metric.submit_time AS submitTime, CONCAT(IFNULL(answer_metric.typing_score, 0), '/', IFNULL(answer_metric.typing_total, 0)) AS typingScore, CONCAT(IFNULL(answer_metric.theory_score, 0), '/', IFNULL(answer_metric.theory_total, 0)) AS theoryScore, CONCAT(IFNULL(answer_metric.practical_score, 0), '/', IFNULL(answer_metric.practical_total, 0)) AS practicalScore ,CONCAT(IFNULL(answer_metric.file_practical_score, 0), '/', IFNULL(answer_metric.file_practical_total, 0)) AS filePracticalScore ,CONCAT(IFNULL(answer_metric.python_practical_score, 0), '/', IFNULL(answer_metric.python_practical_total, 0)) AS pythonPracticalScore ,CONCAT(IFNULL(answer_metric.flowchart_practical_score, 0), '/', IFNULL(answer_metric.flowchart_practical_total, 0)) AS flowchartPracticalScore FROM answer_metric INNER JOIN biz_lesson lesson ON lesson.lesson_id = answer_metric.lesson_id LEFT JOIN lesson_total ON lesson_total.lesson_id = answer_metric.lesson_id ORDER BY answer_metric.submit_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_student_answer SET preview_status = #{previewStatus}, preview_path = #{previewPath}, preview_retry_count = #{previewRetryCount}, preview_last_retry_time = #{previewLastRetryTime}, preview_error_message = #{previewErrorMessage} WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}

UPDATE biz_student_answer SET student_answer = '', is_correct = 0, score = NULL, submit_time = #{submitTime}, preview_status = NULL, preview_path = NULL, preview_retry_count = 0, preview_last_retry_time = NULL, preview_error_message = NULL, practical_artifact_id = #{practicalArtifactId}, practical_version_id = NULL WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}

UPDATE biz_student_answer SET preview_status = 'converting', preview_path = NULL, preview_retry_count = IFNULL(preview_retry_count, 0), preview_error_message = NULL WHERE answer_id = #{answerId} AND preview_status = 'pending' AND preview_path IS NULL

SELECT s.student_id, u.nick_name as student_name, s.student_no, s.class_code as class_name, a.question_id, lq.order_num, a.student_answer, a.is_correct, a.score, q.question_content FROM biz_student s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a1.* FROM biz_student_answer a1 INNER JOIN (
) latest ON latest.answer_id = a1.answer_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question current_lq ON current_lq.lesson_id = a1.lesson_id AND current_lq.question_id = a1.question_id ) a ON s.user_id = a.student_id AND a.lesson_id = #{lessonId} LEFT JOIN biz_lesson_question lq ON a.question_id = lq.question_id AND lq.lesson_id = #{lessonId} LEFT JOIN biz_question q ON a.question_id = q.question_id WHERE s.class_code = #{classCode} AND s.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY CAST(s.student_no AS UNSIGNED) ASC, lq.order_num ASC

SELECT s.class_code AS classCode, s.entry_year AS entryYear, COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) AS totalStudents, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'practical' AND a.student_answer IS NOT NULL THEN a.student_id END) AS practicalSubmitted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN q.question_type = 'practical' AND a.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND a.score IS NULL THEN a.student_id END) AS practicalUngraded FROM biz_student_answer a INNER JOIN (
) latest ON latest.answer_id = a.answer_id JOIN biz_student s ON a.student_id = s.user_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question lq ON lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND lq.question_id = a.question_id JOIN biz_question q ON a.question_id = q.question_id WHERE a.lesson_id = #{lessonId} GROUP BY s.class_code, s.entry_year ORDER BY s.entry_year DESC, s.class_code ASC

SELECT class_scope.classCode AS classCode, class_scope.entryYear AS entryYear, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN s.student_id END) AS totalStudents, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NOT NULL AND q.question_type = 'practical' AND ans.student_answer IS NOT NULL THEN s.student_id END) AS practicalSubmitted, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NOT NULL AND q.question_type = 'practical' AND ans.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND ans.score IS NULL THEN s.student_id END) AS practicalUngraded, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN u.user_id IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(p.is_absent, 0) = 0 AND (ans.student_id IS NOT NULL OR p.performance_id IS NOT NULL) THEN s.student_id END) AS scoreReadyCount FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT la.class_code AS classCode, la.entry_year AS entryYear FROM biz_lesson_assignment la WHERE la.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND (la.dept_id = #{deptId} OR la.dept_id IS NULL) UNION SELECT DISTINCT s.class_code AS classCode, s.entry_year AS entryYear FROM biz_student_answer a INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(answer_id) AS answer_id FROM biz_student_answer WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} GROUP BY student_id, lesson_id, question_id ) latest ON latest.answer_id = a.answer_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question current_lq ON current_lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND current_lq.question_id = a.question_id INNER JOIN biz_student s ON a.student_id = s.user_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id INNER JOIN biz_teacher_class tc ON s.entry_year = tc.entry_year AND s.class_code = tc.class_code AND u.dept_id = tc.dept_id WHERE a.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND tc.user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND tc.dept_id = #{deptId} ) class_scope INNER JOIN biz_teacher_class tc ON class_scope.entryYear = tc.entry_year AND class_scope.classCode = tc.class_code AND tc.user_id = #{teacherUserId} AND tc.dept_id = #{deptId} LEFT JOIN biz_student s ON s.entry_year = class_scope.entryYear AND s.class_code = class_scope.classCode LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.user_id = u.user_id AND u.dept_id = tc.dept_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT a1.* FROM biz_student_answer a1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(answer_id) AS answer_id FROM biz_student_answer WHERE lesson_id = #{lessonId} GROUP BY student_id, lesson_id, question_id ) latest ON latest.answer_id = a1.answer_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question current_lq ON current_lq.lesson_id = a1.lesson_id AND current_lq.question_id = a1.question_id WHERE a1.lesson_id = #{lessonId} ) ans ON ans.student_id = s.user_id LEFT JOIN biz_question q ON ans.question_id = q.question_id LEFT JOIN biz_classroom_performance p ON p.student_id = s.student_id AND p.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND (p.dept_id = #{deptId} OR p.dept_id IS NULL) GROUP BY class_scope.entryYear, class_scope.classCode ORDER BY class_scope.entryYear DESC, CAST(class_scope.classCode AS UNSIGNED) ASC, class_scope.classCode ASC

SELECT a.* FROM biz_student_answer a INNER JOIN (
) latest ON latest.answer_id = a.answer_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question current_lq ON current_lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND current_lq.question_id = a.question_id INNER JOIN biz_question q ON q.question_id = a.question_id WHERE q.question_type = 'practical' AND a.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND a.student_answer != '' AND (LOWER(a.student_answer) LIKE '%.docx' OR LOWER(a.student_answer) LIKE '%.doc') AND a.preview_path IS NULL AND ( (a.preview_status = 'failed' AND (a.preview_last_retry_time IS NULL OR a.preview_last_retry_time <= #{retryBefore})) OR (a.preview_status IN ('pending', 'converting') AND COALESCE(a.preview_last_retry_time, a.submit_time) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(a.preview_last_retry_time, a.submit_time) <= #{stuckBefore}) ) AND IFNULL(a.preview_retry_count, 0) < #{maxRetryCount} ORDER BY a.submit_time ASC

SELECT a.* FROM biz_student_answer a INNER JOIN (
) latest ON latest.answer_id = a.answer_id INNER JOIN biz_lesson_question current_lq ON current_lq.lesson_id = a.lesson_id AND current_lq.question_id = a.question_id INNER JOIN biz_question q ON q.question_id = a.question_id INNER JOIN biz_student s ON s.user_id = a.student_id INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = s.user_id WHERE q.question_type = 'practical' AND a.lesson_id = #{lessonId} AND a.question_id = #{questionId} AND s.class_code = #{classCode} AND s.entry_year = #{entryYear} AND u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND a.student_answer IS NOT NULL AND a.student_answer != '' AND (LOWER(a.student_answer) LIKE '%.docx' OR LOWER(a.student_answer) LIKE '%.doc') AND a.preview_path IS NULL AND ( a.preview_status = 'failed' OR (a.preview_status IN ('pending', 'converting') AND COALESCE(a.preview_last_retry_time, a.submit_time) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(a.preview_last_retry_time, a.submit_time) <= #{stuckBefore}) ) ORDER BY CAST(s.student_no AS UNSIGNED) ASC, a.submit_time ASC
